title: Credit Line Ranges and Account Standing Thresholds — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
Northgate Business credit sets each Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) credit line within the range of the account's terms tier, and the same tier fixes how far the balance may run above the line and the days-past-due marks at which the account's standing changes.

## Underwriting ranges and standing thresholds

| Terms tier | Lowest credit line at opening (USD) | Highest credit line on the tier (USD) | Over-line tolerance (percent above the line) | Credit hold at (days past due) | Collections at (days past due) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 1000 | 5000 | 0.0 | 30 | 120 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 2500 | 25000 | 5.0 | 30 | 120 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 10000 | 75000 | 10.0 | 45 | 120 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 25000 | 250000 | 10.0 | 45 | 150 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 100000 | 1000000 | 10.0 | 60 | 180 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 5000 | 500000 | 10.0 | 90 | 365 |

## What each column means

- **Lowest credit line at opening** — the lowest line the tier opens with, in US dollars.
- **Highest credit line on the tier** — the highest line the tier allows, in US dollars.
- **Over-line tolerance** — the percent above the credit line that the balance may reach before new invoiced orders are held. A tolerance of 0.0, as on Net 15, leaves no room above the line.
- **Credit hold at** — the days an invoice is past due at which new invoiced orders are held.
- **Collections at** — the days an invoice is past due at which the account is closed and referred to collections.

## Reading across the tiers (hypothetical lines)

| Hypothetical credit line | Tier | Tolerance | Highest balance within tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|
| $4000 | Net 15 | 0.0 percent | $4000.00 |
| $20000 | Net 30 Standard | 5.0 percent | $21000.00 |
| $60000 | Net 30 Preferred | 10.0 percent | $66000.00 |

The highest balance within tolerance is the credit line plus the tolerance percent of that line.
